column1: # Persona 3 Reload (Switch 2): ATLUS's game on Unreal Engine 4.27 (project xrd777; IoStore, MallocBinned3), SDK built for the Switch 2 (Ounce), NVN2; the base game with update v262144.
# Started from the NSP script's provisional profile (dm/games/profile_guess.py); see README.md
# the NUP has no control data, so the update's display version is not known
# The game sets near = 0 (nvnDeviceSetDepthMode) at boot: the pipeline bases made before it runs are made for that mode
# Unreal: nninitStartup reserves a 62 GB address region and its FMallocBinned3 takes 37 GB of it, so a 64 GB alias region on the Mac. The rewriter cuts the allocator in any Unreal 4 / 5 main

# (dm/tools/ue_malloc.py) and gives the region what the alias region has room for (dm/tools/ue_region.py). In its first 15 s in nnMain the game's regions reach alias +62.06 GB. Not fitted for an iPhone
# the sdk is built for the Switch 2 (Ounce): its 9 GB pool
# the NPDM declares 80 MB of system resource
# Compute shaders that pick images from c2's image table at run time (cp_i2d_cb0_40000000_, cp_i2da_, cp_i3d_): Ryujinx makes those 32-entry arrays indexed by the handle's texture ID, which
# the replay fills with the bound image slots while c2 holds slot indices (nvn_refl.m / nvn_mtl.m). Without it 150 of them failed reflection conversion
# Each material's shaders inline in its cooked package (UE 4.27's SF_GLSL_SAGE: LSLG records with an NVN2 control section), the packages in the IoStore containers (pakchunk*-Sage.utoc), the
# global shaders in pakchunk0-Sage.pak; pakchunk1, 2 and 4 hold audio and fonts only (shader_split.py ue_legacy_jobs)
